# Your first successful call (enterprise quickstart)

Goal: from a fresh enterprise account to two working API calls in under 20 minutes. No prior context assumed.

## Before you start (1 min)
- You have an org and an API key.
- Pick the SDK for your language (this guide uses Python).

## Step 1 — Authenticate (3 min)
Set your key as an environment variable (not in code), install the SDK, and run the minimal example. If you get a 401, the key isn't on your path — re-check the env var.

## Step 2 — Your first call (5 min)
Send a single chat completion. Expected: a response object you can print. If you hit a 429 rate-limit error, you're on the default tier — see *Tiers & limits* below; you do not need to change code.

## Step 3 — A second, real call (7 min)
Make one call that reflects your actual use case (e.g. summarize a document). This is the step telemetry shows most new orgs never reach — completing it is the strongest predictor of staying.

## Tiers & limits (reference)
A short table of tiers and what raises them, so day-one 429s don't read as failure.

## Where to go next
Links to the long-context decision guide and the agents path.

> Facilitator note: this quickstart targets the '70% never make a second call' signal — the success metric is the 7-day second-call rate, not completion of step 1.
